title: Sources: in a reshuffle, LinkedIn CEO Ryan Roslansky will lead Microsoft's new Work Experiences Group, including Teams, after 35-year veteran Rajesh Jha retired (Tom Warren/The Verge)
summary: Tom Warren / The Verge: Sources: in a reshuffle, LinkedIn CEO Ryan Roslansky will lead Microsoft's new Work Experiences Group, including Teams, after 35-year veteran Rajesh Jha retired — The departure of veteran executive Rajesh Jha has triggered big organizational changes inside Microsoft.
